name: FAA Mid-Atlantic hybrid-electric demonstration flights
country_or_region: Virginia, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, United States
known_limitations: The August 2026 flights are demonstrations within the eVTOL Integration Pilot Program. They do not establish aircraft certification, scheduled commercial service, passenger demand, route economics, reliability, or scaled airport integration.
automation_notes: Keep demonstration route, participating authorities, and program stage exact; never translate the flight into commercial-service evidence.
